title: Chapter 516
text:
Kedan was a citizen of Godora, and there was a small risk involved in this kidnapping. Thankfully, Kedan only lived on the fringes of society on Colony Planet Gautin, and the Sky Ring mercenaries spent some effort to bring him over. However, according to them, there were two other people present at the scene, and there were many loopholes in this matter. After all, it was not Han Xiao who personally led this operation.

There was a risk involved, and even if it was a shut-in who did not work, Godora would still protect their citizens. However, Han Xiao would not release Kedan. Although Kedan's actions were against the law in Godora, and he would be convicted if he was released, Godora would not compensate Blue Star for this.

However, in the Interstellar Era, the movement between planets was extremely fast, and many citizens did not live on Colony Planet Gautin. Instead, they would take spaceships to other Star Systems. The huge population and complex distribution of the population resulted in more freedom in the administration of law and order. It was a small matter for a citizen living on the fringes of the Colony Planet Gautin to be kidnapped. The local law and order department did not have the manpower to pursue this matter into the universe, and the efficiency was not high.

As long as Godora could not find Kedan, this kidnapping would be left unsolved. After all, it was just a case of an ordinary person going missing, and it was impossible for them to invest a huge amount of resources to search for him. If they could not find him for a period of time, it would become an unsolved case. The Sky Ring mercenaries had activated stealth on the way, and it was difficult to track them after they jumped. At the end of the day, they were not teammates, and Han Xiao was very gratified.

"You remind me of my hometown." Risda's voice suddenly sounded from the cockpit.

"It's very tragic, isn't it?" Han Xiao shook his head.

"At least there's still hope." After saying that, Risda fell silent again. He had always been in the Blacklight Stealth, controlling the spaceship, and did not like to show his face.

Risda allowed Han Xiao to use his body and was very cooperative. Han Xiao also did not let Philip control the spaceship. In terms of artificial intelligence, Risda was naturally much better than Philip. After all, he was an AI lifeform.

The Blacklight Stealth landed in the Sanctuary, and Han Xiao instructed Bennett not to kill Kedan for the time being before he went about his own business.

As usual, he inspected the situation of the recruitment and checked on Sylvia's homework. Then, he returned to his residence and checked the quest reward: 8,000,000 EXP, one chance of a Random Reward, which he had not used yet. In addition, he was also rewarded with 2 Free Attribute Points and 1 Potential Point. High difficulty quests would reward some attribute points.

The best reward was naturally the Medal of Honor, which increased all attributes by 3%.

[You have gained]

This thing was the same as the Character Summon Card. It would take effect immediately on the interface. He still had the Medal of Honor from the Germinal Organization mission. It had the same effect, but only one could be used at a time. Only by collecting three Medals of Honor would he be able to exchange them for a special badge that increased all attributes by 12%.

After looking at the rewards, Han Xiao opened his status window. Today was a good day. He had finally finished practicing Harmon's Energy Training Technique, and his energy had broken through the 9,000 mark. He had finally entered the next level and obtained a new bonus.

Energy Attribute: – Increases Machinery Affinity.

Energy: + 18 STR, + 25 DEX, + 28 END, + 32 INT, + 22 MYS, + 3,400 Maximum Stamina, + 25% Machinery Affinity

Just this level of attributes alone increased his Energy Points bonus by almost a third. The higher his Energy Points were, the more significant the bonus would be for each level.

The Class Advancement mission had been completed, and the Class Advancement requirement was to choose a specialization from the three branches of Large Machinery, Micro Machinery, and Virtual Technology. The method was to max out the relevant High-End Knowledge.

Han Xiao had not bought any of the three branches of Armed, Energy, and Control. However, he was planning to choose the Virtual Technology specialization, so it did not affect him much.

Virtual Technology was mainly used for infiltration, defense, and so on. It was very powerful in battles between Mechanics. It could basically be summed up as' what's yours is mine, and what's mine is still mine '. Even if it did not infiltrate, it could prevent other Mechanics from taking away their machinery.

Furthermore, Virtual Technology and the Army Style complemented each other. The stronger one was, the larger the army one could control, and the further the range. In the galaxy, he was not the only one who could build a Mech Army. If one was good at Virtual Technology, they would be able to counter the Army Style to a certain extent.

Virtual Technology also had its weaknesses. When facing opponents other than the Mechanic class, it was not as strong as the Large Machinery and Micro Machinery paths. After all, the strength of these two paths was very obvious. Their combat power was on the table, and it was nothing more than stacking up the attributes of the machinery.

He had played these two paths in his previous life, and the machinery he created was even stronger. He just had to close his eyes and leave it all up to fate.

Of course, this was an exaggeration. The experts of these two branches still had to operate the battle. Only those who did not want to operate the battle would be able to do it.

In his previous life, the majority of players had chosen these two paths because the difficulty of the Virtual Technology branch was too high.

More importantly, even if one did not choose the Army Style, the Large Machinery and Micro Machinery paths also had many strong battle strategies. However, the Virtual Technology branch was most suitable for the Army Style.

Players preferred battle strategies that were more economical. After all, it was not easy to earn money. Was the Army Style something that poor people could play?

From Han Xiao's experience, the Virtual Technology branch was the best. Although it did not have as obvious an advantage as the other two paths, the Virtual Technology branch was very stable in actual combat. It had advantages in internal battles, and it was definitely not weak when facing opponents of other classes. After all, he was still a Mechanic, and his foundation was still there.

Han Xiao did not pursue the maximum attributes of a single machine. If he did not have enough quality, he could make up for it with quantity. With the huge market of players, he was not worried about the cost. Compared to strengthening his strengths, he preferred to make up for his weaknesses.

As long as he had enough experience, he could even raise the level of his blueprints and manufacturing skills very high. This way, even the quality of his machinery would not be much worse than the other two paths.

Furthermore, he had a more personal reason for choosing the Virtual Technology branch.

You have completed the LV 120 Promotion. END bonus increased! 1 END = 65 HP = 75 Stamina

"At this level of promotion, the amount of HP converted from END is much higher. At the start, every promotion would increase the HP conversion by 5 points. After the first Race Evolution, every promotion would increase the HP conversion by 10 points. Now, it has increased by 15 points. Previously, the HP conversion rate was 1: 50, but now, it is 1: 65."

You have reached LV 5 (max). Class Promotion successful!

You have received a new class. + 150 Energy, + 3 DEX, + 3 END, + 6 INT. You have received 6 Free Attribute Points and 1 Potential Point.

You have learned a new skill!

You have learned a new skill!

You have learned a new skill!

You have learned a new skill!

You have learned a new skill!

You have learned a new skill!

You have learned a new talent!

The new talents were basically all skills that strengthened the Virtual Technology branch, such as hacking calculations, artificial intelligence defense, and network defense. They were the core of this branch.

It slightly increased the overall attributes of an independent machine. The skill introduction was "Excellent Intelligent System Improves Machine Efficiency".

The former was to reduce the cost of production, while the latter was to increase the production speed. The Virtual Technology branch was the most suitable for the Army Style.

This was the core skill of the Mechanic class, and the effect when it was raised to the max level was + 60% Machinery Affinity. As for the new talent, it gave him an additional bonus to the Virtual Technology branch, similar to that effect.

Because this was a Class Advancement that confirmed his specialization, he learned more skills than before. These skills were even more important than simply leveling up. Without any hesitation, Han Xiao directly leveled up all these skills to the maximum level, hoping to obtain the strongest effect.

In the past few days, he had obtained more than three billion experience points from the players by teaching them skills. Raising all of these advanced skills to the max level burned through more than one billion experience points.

The investment was worth it, and the effect was obvious. His combat power had increased by more than 800 Ona. After reaching the Advanced level, the increase in combat power from the skills even exceeded the effect of leveling up.

He still had 2.2 billion experience points left. At this level, the cost of leveling up his main class was also extremely high. Similarly, the experience reward from the missions that the players came in contact with would also increase, but it would still take a long time to accumulate.

Only Han Xiao could accumulate such a large amount of experience points in such a short time.

All of the experience points were invested into leveling up, and his main class leveled up four times. The remaining experience points could be used to level up one more time. However, Han Xiao stopped and did not continue to level up his main class. Instead, he used the remaining experience points to level up his secondary class from Lv.5 to the max level of Lv.10. In the end, he still had more than 100,000,000 experience points left, which was not enough to level up anymore.

The cost of leveling up his secondary class would increase along with his overall level, but it was still much lower than leveling up his main class. This attribute class was somewhat useful, as it gave him another 50 Intelligence and 5 Potential Points.

After leveling up to Lv.5, the total bonus was 15 Dexterity, 15 Endurance, 30 Intelligence, 30 Free Attribute Points, and 5 Potential Points.

All of the Free Attribute Points were thrown into Intelligence as usual.

Energy boiled in his body. Enduring the discomfort, Han Xiao carefully looked at his attributes that had greatly changed.

Level: 130

Main Class: Mechanic

Race: Void Prowler (Human Form)

181 STR, 401 DEX, 361 END, 1110 INT, 124 MYS, 41 CHA, 1 LUK

Free Attribute Points: 0

Potential Points: 49

Health: 37824

Stamina: 37995

Energy: 9,770

Lv.10 Energy Bonus: + 71 STR, + 97 DEX, + 108 END, + 122 INT, + 77 MYS, + 10920 Stamina Limit, + 85% Machinery Affinity

Energy Rank: 8,945 Ona

Grade: B +

Heh, this remark is quite naughty.

Level 130, close to 9,000 combat power. If I calculate, as long as I reach Lv.140 and complete the Promotion, I will officially enter Grade A and have the destructive power of a calamity.

Han Xiao calculated in his mind. Although he leveled up quickly, he did not fall behind in terms of skill levels. Furthermore, most of the skills he leveled up were in his main class, so his progress was about twenty to thirty levels ahead of the players. His actual combat power was also above the average standard of his level. He could basically sweep through most Grade B Supers.

If he faced Ashes again now, even if he did not plan beforehand, he would be able to fight for a long time.

Even if he could not win, he would be able to disgust the other party to death.

This was especially so for his health. Every time he saw this number, Han Xiao could not help but feel numb. In his previous life, when he was at this level, the average health of a Mechanic was less than 20,000. Even the main tanks of his level did not have as much health as him!

This Molding Talent was simply too ferocious. If he allowed this talent to level up again, he would probably vomit just by looking at it.

Leveling up from Lv.130 to Lv.140 required billions of experience. He had used the skills he taught to harvest a wave of players, and most of the profits had already been earned. At this time, he could still earn about one billion experience from selling the skills. After that, he would have to find new ways to harvest the players.

It had been so many days since the start of the version, and the experience of the players had basically been used up. He had to wait for their experience reserves to accumulate again.

Looks like I still need some time. Han Xiao was already very satisfied. At this level, he could not expect to level up twenty times in a row like in the early stages.

The pain lasted for more than an hour before it slowly subsided. Han Xiao exhaled, feeling full of strength for a while. His stomach was very hungry, and only after gnawing on a dozen concentrated energy bars did his hungry body replenish its nutrients.

He took off his sweat-soaked clothes and looked down at his muscular body. Then, he changed into a dry shirt and put on Qiuqiu again.

Beep beep …

At this time, the communicator rang. Herlous was requesting a call.

"If you're here to show off your new arm, you can end the call now." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and wore a compressed orb bracelet on his wrist.

"No, this is a serious matter." Herlous frowned and said in a low voice, "Nagojin sent out a recruitment notice to the Inhumans. Many Inhumans were attracted to watch …"

The way Herlous saw it, the players were all good helpers that could help Sunil survive the Catastrophe. However, Godora was actually trying to poach them. He was furious.

"Oh?"

Han Xiao's eyes moved, and a smile appeared on his face. "Hehe, you're indeed waving your hoe at me. Don't blame me for being unkind. I'll go and take a look later."

— — —
